description: Demolition and reconstruction of the existing single-storey rear extension, replacement of the rear dormer, installation of a new front dormer, replacement roofing incorporating three rooflights, replacement of the front door and windows throughout, installation of a new flank wall window, installation of an air-conditioning condenser unit, erection of a front boundary wall and brick pier, and provision of a bike and bin store within the front garden.
